en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped outdoor swimming or bathing complex with a large rectangular/irregular pool or pond, low concrete edges, bushes set in the water, and tall trees lining the background. A multi‑storey building stands behind the pool amid the trees. The image has a white border, with printed captions at the bottom indicating the location.
